crowd_agony.wav.notes: Crowd-in-agony bed built by build_agony_bed.py from 20 layered, pitch-spread pain vocalisations in the vocal_fx library, with distance treatment. A DERIVED work: the 344 Audio EULA permits modify/edit/combine, and it carries the SAME restrictions as its sources — mix-only, never a model input, never redistributed. Built with ffmpeg DSP only (resample + filters); no model was involved, so the no-AI-training clause is not engaged.
